scope: Rest of Capital Area (Hays, Bastrop, Caldwell, Burnet, Blanco, Llano, Fayette, Lee counties) - basic needs

records.name: Hays County Food Bank - Client Choice Market and Distributions
records.description_en: The food bank gives free groceries at its Client Choice Market in San Marcos and at weekly food distributions in Kyle, Buda, and Wimberley. At the market you can choose up to 80 pounds of food.
records.description_es: El banco de comida da comida gratis en su Mercado de Libre Elección (Client Choice Market) en San Marcos y en repartos semanales en Kyle, Buda y Wimberley. En el mercado usted puede escoger hasta 80 libras de comida.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in Hays County who need food. The Client Choice Market is by appointment only, one visit per household every 30 days.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas en el condado de Hays que necesitan comida. El Mercado de Libre Elección es solo con cita, una visita por hogar cada 30 días.
records.how_to_apply: Call (512) 392-8300 to make a Client Choice Market appointment (one per household every 30 days). Or go to a weekly distribution site: Kyle on Tuesdays at 1 pm (walk-up), Buda on Thursdays 12:00-12:45 pm (drive-thru), or Wimberley on the 1st Wednesday 5:00-5:45 pm (drive-thru).
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (512) 392-8300 para hacer una cita en el Mercado de Libre Elección (una por hogar cada 30 días). O vaya a un reparto semanal: Kyle los martes a la 1 pm (a pie), Buda los jueves de 12:00 a 12:45 pm (en carro), o Wimberley el primer miércoles del mes de 5:00 a 5:45 pm (en carro).
records.hours: Office: Mon 8am-6pm; Tue-Thu 8am-4pm; Fri 8am-12pm. Client Choice Market by appointment only.
records.notes: Weekly sites: Kyle - St. Anthony Catholic Church, 801 Burleson St (walk-up Tue 1pm); Buda - Buda City Park, 204 San Antonio St (drive-thru Thu 12:00-12:45pm); Wimberley - Cypress Creek Church, 211 Stillwater (drive-thru 1st Wed 5:00-5:45pm). Check the site for schedule changes. Extension 225 from the raw data was not shown on the official page, so only the main number is listed.

records.name: Bastrop County Emergency Food Pantry - Food Assistance
records.organization: Bastrop County Emergency Food Pantry & Support Center
records.description_en: The pantry gives emergency food to Bastrop County families once every 30 days. It also offers fresh food, a backpack program for kids, and help applying for SNAP, Medicaid, and TANF.
records.description_es: La despensa da comida de emergencia a familias del condado de Bastrop una vez cada 30 días. También ofrece comida fresca, un programa de mochilas con comida para niños y ayuda para solicitar SNAP, Medicaid y TANF.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Bastrop County residents who are 18 or older and head of their household. People without a home should tell staff at intake.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para residentes del condado de Bastrop que tienen 18 años o más y son jefes de su hogar. Si no tiene casa, avísele al personal cuando se registre.
documents_needed: Photo ID (driver's license, state ID, passport, consulate ID, or birth certificate)
Proof of Bastrop County address (current utility bill or official mail)
records.how_to_apply: Make an appointment online (the pantry's appointment portal) or by phone, then come at your exact appointment time. After your first intake you can get food once every 30 days for six months; after that you need a new intake.
records.how_to_apply_es: Haga una cita en línea (en el portal de citas de la despensa) o por teléfono, y llegue a la hora exacta de su cita. Después de registrarse por primera vez, puede recibir comida una vez cada 30 días por seis meses; después tiene que registrarse de nuevo.
records.hours: Office Mon-Fri 8:00am-3:00pm. Food assistance Mon, Wed, Fri 8:30-11:30am and 1:30-3:00pm, by appointment only.
records.notes: Appointments are strict: staff will not serve before or after the scheduled time; late arrivals must reschedule. Seniors only redo intake once a year. Online appointments: https://portal.soxbox.co/pantry/bastrop-county-emergency-food-pantry. Email info@bastropfoodpantry.org. Some third-party listings show an old address (806 Fayette St); the pantry's own contact page lists 1201 Pine Street.

records.name: Caldwell County Food Pantry
records.description_en: The pantry gives monthly grocery baskets to families in Caldwell County. It also runs the HOPE food program for seniors, school backpacks, a weekly meal program, and mobile food distributions in Luling and Dale.
records.description_es: La despensa da canastas de comida cada mes a familias del condado de Caldwell. También tiene el programa HOPE de comida para personas mayores, mochilas escolares, un programa de comidas semanales y repartos móviles de comida en Luling y Dale.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Caldwell County families who need food. Call the pantry to ask what you need to bring.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias del condado de Caldwell que necesitan comida. Llame a la despensa para preguntar qué debe llevar.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the pantry in Lockhart during open hours or call (512) 376-6661 to ask about intake.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite la despensa en Lockhart durante el horario de atención o llame al (512) 376-6661 para preguntar cómo registrarse.
records.notes: Intake email: intake@caldwellfoodpantry.com. Mobile distributions in Luling and Dale; times not listed on the site, so call first. HOPE program serves seniors. Eligibility rules are not posted on the site; call to confirm.

records.name: The Helping Center Food Pantry
records.organization: The Helping Center of Marble Falls
records.description_en: The Helping Center gives food to families in the Marble Falls area, including fresh produce and bread. It may also give limited financial help and referrals to other services.
records.description_es: The Helping Center da comida a familias del área de Marble Falls, incluyendo frutas, verduras y pan. También puede dar un poco de ayuda con dinero y referirle a otros servicios.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people in need in southern Burnet County, including people out of work, families going through a change like divorce or a death, survivors of abuse, seniors on fixed incomes, and people with disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con necesidad en el sur del condado de Burnet, incluyendo personas sin trabajo, familias pasando por un cambio como un divorcio o una muerte, personas que sufrieron abuso, personas mayores con ingresos fijos y personas con discapacidades.
records.how_to_apply: Visit during open hours. Check in at least 15 minutes before closing.
records.how_to_apply_es: Venga durante el horario de atención. Regístrese por lo menos 15 minutos antes de la hora de cierre.
records.notes: Email info@helpingcenter.org. Documents required were not listed on the site; call ahead. Financial help is limited.

records.name: Central Texas Food Bank - Find Food Now
records.description_en: The regional food bank supplies local pantries and mobile food pantries. Use its Find Food Now tool to find free food near your ZIP code, and get help applying for SNAP.
records.description_es: El banco de comida regional abastece a despensas locales y despensas móviles. Use su herramienta "Find Food Now" para encontrar comida gratis cerca de su código postal, y reciba ayuda para solicitar SNAP.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For anyone in its 21-county area who needs food. You may be asked to fill out a short form saying you live in the area and need food, but ID, proof of income, or citizenship are not required.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para cualquier persona en su área de 21 condados que necesite comida. Puede que le pidan llenar un formulario corto diciendo que vive en el área y necesita comida, pero no le pueden pedir identificación, prueba de ingresos ni prueba de ciudadanía.
records.how_to_apply: Enter your ZIP code on the Get Help page to find pantries and mobile pantry dates. For SNAP application help, call 855-366-3401.
records.how_to_apply_es: Escriba su código postal en la página "Get Help" para encontrar despensas y fechas de despensas móviles. Para ayuda con la solicitud de SNAP, llame al 855-366-3401.
records.notes: Counties confirmed on https://www.centraltexasfoodbank.org/about-us (21 counties, also includes Travis, Williamson and others). Call 512-684-2559 to check weather or holiday closures. SNAP help line: 855-366-3401.

records.name: Meals on Wheels Rural Capital Area
records.description_en: This program brings meals to homebound seniors and serves group meals for seniors at meal sites. A $2.50 donation is suggested but not required.
records.description_es: Este programa lleva comidas a personas mayores que no pueden salir de casa y sirve comidas en grupo para personas mayores en centros de comida. Se sugiere una donación de $2.50, pero no es obligatoria.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Group meals are for people 60 and older and their spouses. Home-delivered meals are for people 60+ who are homebound and cannot cook, or people under 60 with a disability who are on Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Las comidas en grupo son para personas de 60 años o más y sus cónyuges. Las comidas a domicilio son para personas de 60 años o más que no pueden salir de casa y no pueden cocinar, o personas menores de 60 con una discapacidad que tienen Medicaid.
records.how_to_apply: Call (800) 333-6325 or (979) 540-2980, or email nbuck@ccaction.com with the subject 'MOWRCA Inquiry'.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (800) 333-6325 o al (979) 540-2980, o mande un correo a nbuck@ccaction.com con el asunto 'MOWRCA Inquiry'.
records.notes: Program has a waitlist due to funding limits. Some people under 60 with disabilities may qualify for group meals.

records.name: Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP) - Bastrop, Fayette, Lee
records.description_en: CEAP helps low-income households pay electric, gas, and propane bills. It also teaches ways to lower energy use.
records.description_es: CEAP ayuda a hogares de bajos ingresos a pagar las cuentas de luz, gas y propano. También enseña maneras de usar menos energía.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households in Bastrop, Fayette, and Lee counties (the agency also serves Austin, Colorado, and Fort Bend counties). Help depends on funding.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares de bajos ingresos en los condados de Bastrop, Fayette y Lee (la agencia también atiende los condados de Austin, Colorado y Fort Bend). La ayuda depende de los fondos disponibles.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online with the application linked on the Family Services page, or call (979) 540-2980 to ask for help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud en línea que está en la página de Servicios para Familias (Family Services), o llame al (979) 540-2980 para pedir ayuda.
records.notes: This is the CEAP provider for Bastrop, Fayette, and Lee counties. Hays, Caldwell, and Blanco are served for CEAP by Community Action, Inc. of Central Texas. Online application: https://form.jotform.com/233526383350050. Office hours are from the agency home page (Giddings office). A separate CEAP phone line and priority groups seen in search results were not confirmed on the agency's page and were removed.

records.name: Tenant Based Rental Assistance (TBRA)
records.description_en: TBRA helps pay rent and security deposits for up to 24 months. Families also work with a case manager on a self-sufficiency plan.
records.description_es: TBRA ayuda a pagar la renta y el depósito de seguridad por hasta 24 meses. Las familias también trabajan con un administrador de casos en un plan para ser autosuficientes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For households at or below 80% of Area Median Family Income in the listed counties who agree to case management and a self-sufficiency plan.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares con ingresos del 80% o menos del Ingreso Medio Familiar del Área (AMFI) en los condados que se indican, que acepten trabajar con un administrador de casos y un plan de autosuficiencia.
documents_needed: Proof of current monthly income (pay stubs, Social Security or SSI letters, child support statements, etc.)
A written letter explaining your situation, needs, and how the program would help your family's plan
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the online application form, or call (979) 540-2980 with questions.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud en línea, o llame al (979) 540-2980 si tiene preguntas.
records.notes: Also serves Colorado, Austin, and Travis counties (Travis excludes Austin city limits). Income limit is 80% of Area Median Family Income (AMFI), not FPL. Includes help with security deposits. Depends on available funding. Email info@ccaction.com.

records.name: Home Weatherization Program
records.description_en: The weatherization program makes homes more energy efficient so power bills go down. It focuses on repairs that save energy, not on looks.
records.description_es: El programa de climatización (weatherization) ayuda a que su casa use menos energía para que bajen sus cuentas de luz. Se enfoca en arreglos que ahorran energía, no en cómo se ve la casa.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For eligible low-income households in the listed counties. Call to ask about income limits.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares elegibles de bajos ingresos en los condados que se indican. Llame para preguntar por los límites de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Download the application from the 'Apply Here' link on the website, or call (979) 540-2980.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue la solicitud con el enlace 'Apply Here' en el sitio web, o llame al (979) 540-2980.
records.notes: Also serves Austin, Colorado, and Fort Bend counties. Income limits were not listed on the page. Email info@ccaction.com.

records.name: Children and Pregnant Women (CPW) Case Management
records.description_en: Case managers help children, pregnant women, and their families get medical care and other family support. This is a Medicaid case management service.
records.description_es: Los administradores de casos ayudan a niños, mujeres embarazadas y sus familias a recibir atención médica y otro apoyo para la familia. Es un servicio de administración de casos de Medicaid.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For children and pregnant women (and their families) in the agency's service counties. This is a Medicaid service, so call to check if you qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para niños y mujeres embarazadas (y sus familias) en los condados que atiende la agencia. Es un servicio de Medicaid, así que llame para ver si califica.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online with the application linked on the Family Services page, or call (979) 540-2980.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud en línea que está en la página de Servicios para Familias (Family Services), o llame al (979) 540-2980.
records.notes: Family Services page lists Austin, Bastrop, Colorado, Fayette, Fort Bend, and Lee counties. Online application: https://form.jotform.com/233526383350050. Programs depend on funding. The raw note about school problems was not confirmed and was removed.

records.name: Utility Assistance Program (CEAP) - Hays, Caldwell, Blanco
records.organization: Community Action, Inc. of Central Texas
records.description_en: This program helps low-income families pay electric, natural gas, propane, and butane bills. It also gives energy tips and budget counseling.
records.description_es: Este programa ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar las cuentas de luz, gas natural, propano y butano. También da consejos para ahorrar energía y ayuda para hacer un presupuesto.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households in Hays, Caldwell, and Blanco counties. Priority goes to homes with high energy bills or with a child 5 or under, a person with a disability, a senior, or a veteran.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares de bajos ingresos en los condados de Hays, Caldwell y Blanco. Tienen prioridad los hogares con cuentas de energía altas o con un niño de 5 años o menos, una persona con discapacidad, una persona mayor o un veterano.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Hays, Caldwell, or Blanco County resident

documents_needed: Completed application for every household member 18+
Social Security cards
Photo ID
Proof of income for the past 30 days
Current or past-due utility bills
records.how_to_apply: Apply online (English or Spanish), or print the application and mail it with your documents to Community Action, Inc., PO Box 748, San Marcos, TX 78667-0748. You can also turn it in at an office. Processing can take 4 to 8 weeks, and you still need to pay your bills while you wait.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en línea (en inglés o español), o imprima la solicitud y mándela por correo con sus documentos a Community Action, Inc., PO Box 748, San Marcos, TX 78667-0748. También puede entregarla en una oficina. El trámite puede tardar de 4 a 8 semanas, y usted tiene que seguir pagando sus cuentas mientras espera.
records.notes: This is the CEAP provider for Hays, Caldwell, and Blanco counties. San Marcos phone ext. 309. Caldwell County office: 415 E. Davis Ste. B, Luling, (830) 875-3707 (hours vary slightly). Online application: https://communityaction.jotform.com/260205034794958. Email utilityassistance@communityaction.com. The City of San Marcos page (https://sanmarcostx.gov/4103/Utility-Assistance-Available-to-Hays-Cou) confirms the document list, a 4-8 week processing time, and that you may reapply 90 days after your last payment. A Lockhart office number from the raw data was not confirmed and was removed.

records.name: Tenant Based Rental Assistance (TBRA) - Hays County
records.organization: Community Action, Inc. of Central Texas
records.description_en: TBRA can help pay rent for up to 24 months for Hays County households. The amount you pay depends on your income.
records.description_es: TBRA puede ayudar a pagar la renta por hasta 24 meses a hogares del condado de Hays. La parte que usted paga depende de sus ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Hays County households at or below 80% of Area Median Family Income who have no unpaid rent from last month and will take part in a self-sufficiency plan.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares del condado de Hays con ingresos del 80% o menos del Ingreso Medio Familiar del Área (AMFI), que no deban renta del mes pasado y que acepten seguir un plan de autosuficiencia.
documents_needed: Social Security cards for all household members
Government photo ID for adults
Proof of citizenship for all members (birth certificate, passport, etc.)
Proof of income from the last 30 days
records.how_to_apply: During the open application period, turn in an application in person at 215 S. Reimer Ave., Suite 130, San Marcos (8am-5pm, closed 12-1pm), by mail to PO Box 748, San Marcos, TX 78667-0748 (Attn: TBRA Case Manager), or by fax to (512) 396-4255. People are picked by lottery.
records.how_to_apply_es: Durante el periodo en que se aceptan solicitudes, entregue su solicitud en persona en 215 S. Reimer Ave., Suite 130, San Marcos (8am a 5pm, cerrado de 12 a 1pm), por correo a PO Box 748, San Marcos, TX 78667-0748 (Attn: TBRA Case Manager), o por fax al (512) 396-4255. Las personas se escogen por sorteo.
records.cost: Free (client pays a share of rent based on income)
records.notes: Applications open only during a yearly window, and people are chosen by lottery from the waiting list. The page viewed in Sept 2026 still showed the 2025 window (Jan 15-Feb 13, 2025), so call (512) 392-1161 to ask when applications open next. Income limit is 80% AMFI, not FPL.

records.name: Adult Education (GED/HSE and ESL classes)
records.organization: Community Action, Inc. of Central Texas
records.description_en: Free classes to prepare for the high school equivalency (GED) test in English or Spanish, and English classes for speakers of other languages. Career training and digital skills are also offered.
records.description_es: Clases gratis para prepararse para el examen de equivalencia de preparatoria (GED) en inglés o español, y clases de inglés para personas que hablan otros idiomas. También hay capacitación para empleos y clases de computación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For adults 19 and older who are authorized to work in the U.S. Young people 16-18 who are not in school may qualify; 16-year-olds need a court order for GED classes.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para adultos de 19 años o más con permiso para trabajar en EE. UU. Jóvenes de 16 a 18 años que no están en la escuela pueden calificar; los de 16 años necesitan una orden de la corte para las clases de GED.
documents_needed: One of these: REAL driver's license or state ID (not expired or limited-term) plus Social Security card; U.S. military ID plus Social Security card; U.S. birth certificate plus valid state ID; U.S. passport; U.S. Employment Authorization Card; or Permanent Resident Card
records.how_to_apply: Register online at communityaction.com/registration or call (737) 331-0372.
records.how_to_apply_es: Inscríbase en línea en communityaction.com/registration o llame al (737) 331-0372.
records.notes: Also serves Williamson and rural Travis County. Email adulted@communityaction.com. Classes also include distance education, college prep, and English for internationally trained professionals.

records.name: Head Start
records.organization: Community Action, Inc. of Central Texas
records.description_en: Head Start offers free early learning and preschool services for young children from low-income families.
records.description_es: Head Start ofrece educación temprana y preescolar gratis para niños pequeños de familias de bajos ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For young children in low-income families in Hays and Caldwell counties. Call to check age and income rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para niños pequeños de familias de bajos ingresos en los condados de Hays y Caldwell. Llame para preguntar por los requisitos de edad e ingresos.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out the online application (English or Spanish) linked on the Head Start page, then send documents by secure email, or call (512) 392-1161.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene la solicitud en línea (en inglés o español) que está en la página de Head Start, y luego mande sus documentos por el correo electrónico seguro, o llame al (512) 392-1161.
records.notes: Counties confirmed on https://www.communityaction.com/servicearea. Contact email on page: lsauceda@communityaction.com. Age and income limits were not listed on the page.

records.name: Community Action Health Services - Family Planning and Women's Health
records.organization: Community Action, Inc. of Central Texas
records.description_en: Health programs for low-income men and women in rural Central Texas, including family planning, breast cancer services, HIV services, and help with Medicaid. The agency is a Healthy Texas Women provider.
records.description_es: Programas de salud para hombres y mujeres de bajos ingresos en las zonas rurales del centro de Texas, incluyendo planificación familiar, servicios de cáncer de seno, servicios de VIH y ayuda con Medicaid. La agencia es proveedora de Healthy Texas Women.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income people in the rural areas around Travis County. Family planning is offered in Hays and Caldwell counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas de bajos ingresos en las zonas rurales alrededor del condado de Travis. La planificación familiar se ofrece en los condados de Hays y Caldwell.
records.how_to_apply: Call (512) 392-1161 to ask about services and locations.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (512) 392-1161 para preguntar por los servicios y los lugares de atención.
records.notes: Per https://www.communityaction.com/servicearea, family planning covers Caldwell and Hays; breast cancer outreach and HIV/AIDS help cover all 9 counties (Bastrop, Blanco, Burnet, Caldwell, Fayette, Hays, Lee, Llano, Williamson). Clinic addresses and costs were not listed.

records.name: CARTS Country Bus and Interurban Service
records.description_en: CARTS runs low-cost bus and van rides in rural Central Texas, including Country Bus rides you book ahead for local trips and appointments. All buses and vans are wheelchair accessible.
records.description_es: CARTS ofrece viajes en autobús y camioneta a bajo costo en las zonas rurales del centro de Texas, incluyendo el Country Bus, que usted reserva con anticipación para viajes locales y citas. Todos los autobuses y camionetas son accesibles para sillas de ruedas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the public in its service counties. Half-price fares for seniors 60+, people with disabilities, children under 12, and registered customers; seniors 60+ ride Country Bus free.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto al público en los condados que atiende. Pagan medio pasaje las personas de 60 años o más, personas con discapacidades, niños menores de 12 años y clientes registrados; las personas de 60 años o más viajan gratis en el Country Bus.
records.how_to_apply: Call (512) 478-7433 to book a ride ahead of time, or schedule service online at ridecarts.com. For general questions call (512) 481-1011.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (512) 478-7433 para reservar un viaje con anticipación, o programe el servicio en línea en ridecarts.com. Para preguntas generales, llame al (512) 481-1011.
records.cost: Zone fares: $2 in town, $4 within a county, $6 all-day multi-county; half fare for eligible riders
records.notes: Also serves Travis and Williamson (non-urbanized areas). Fares from https://www.ridecarts.com/fares/. Pay with exact cash, a card, or apps (Token Transit, Transit, CARTS NOW). Country Bus requires an advance reservation. See the separate reduced-fare record for the disability form.

records.name: CARTS Reduced Fare / Disability Discount Eligibility
records.description_en: People with disabilities can get half-price CARTS fares after a doctor or medical professional certifies the disability on a CARTS form.
records.description_es: Las personas con discapacidades pueden pagar medio pasaje en CARTS después de que un médico o profesional de salud certifique la discapacidad en un formulario de CARTS.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people with a disability certified by a physician or qualified medical professional.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas con una discapacidad certificada por un médico o un profesional de salud calificado.
documents_needed: CARTS Discount Eligibility Form signed by a physician or qualified medical professional
records.how_to_apply: Download the Discount Eligibility Form (English or Spanish) from the CARTS disability page, have a doctor or qualified medical professional certify your disability, and mail it to CARTS, P.O. Box 2107, Bastrop, TX 78602-2107.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue el Formulario de Elegibilidad para Descuento (en inglés o español) en la página de discapacidad de CARTS, pida a un médico o profesional de salud calificado que certifique su discapacidad, y mándelo por correo a CARTS, P.O. Box 2107, Bastrop, TX 78602-2107.
records.notes: ADA applications can be mailed to CARTS, 338 S. Guadalupe St., San Marcos, TX 78666, or faxed to (512) 805-0001. Email everyone@ridecarts.com.

records.name: Southside Community Center Housing Stability Programs
records.description_en: Southside gives one-time help with rent or utility bills, eviction prevention with 1-3 months of support, and 30-60 days of transitional shelter with case management.
records.description_es: Southside da ayuda de una sola vez con la renta o las cuentas de servicios, ayuda para evitar un desalojo con 1 a 3 meses de apoyo, y refugio temporal de 30 a 60 días con apoyo de un administrador de casos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: One-time rent or utility help is for Hays County residents with bills under $800. Eviction prevention is for San Marcos residents with bills from $500 to $3,000. Transitional housing requires a drug screen, and pets are not allowed.
records.eligibility_summary_es: La ayuda de una vez con renta o servicios es para residentes del condado de Hays con cuentas de menos de $800. La ayuda para evitar desalojos es para residentes de San Marcos con cuentas de $500 a $3,000. Para la vivienda temporal hay que pasar una prueba de drogas y no se permiten mascotas.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Hays County (San Marcos residents for eviction prevention)

documents_needed: Social Security cards and photo IDs for all household members
Last two pay stubs (or bank statements if self-employed)
Proof of other income (SS, SSI, SNAP, etc.)
Lease or mortgage showing address and monthly payment
Letter from landlord or lender with contact info and amount owed
Most recent utility bill (for utility help)
Eviction or Notice to Vacate papers, if you have them
records.how_to_apply: Applications open on the 1st of each month at 9:00 am and close when full. Apply with the online form, then bring your ID cards to your appointment. Questions: (512) 392-6694 ext. 31.
records.how_to_apply_es: Las solicitudes abren el día 1 de cada mes a las 9:00 am y cierran cuando se llenan. Llene la solicitud en línea y luego lleve sus identificaciones a su cita. Preguntas: (512) 392-6694 ext. 31.
records.notes: Email office@southsidecenter.org. In late Sept 2026 the application page said applications were closed until October 1 because they were full. Older third-party listings describe an overnight shelter and daily meals; Southside's current site does not list these, so confirm by phone before sending someone for shelter or meals.

records.name: Hays-Caldwell Women's Center (HCWC) HELPline, Shelter and Counseling
records.description_en: HCWC helps survivors of family violence, dating violence, sexual assault, and child abuse. It offers a 24-hour HELPline, emergency shelter, counseling, and legal advocacy.
records.description_es: HCWC ayuda a sobrevivientes de violencia familiar, violencia en el noviazgo, agresión sexual y abuso infantil. Ofrece una línea de ayuda (HELPline) las 24 horas, refugio de emergencia, consejería y apoyo legal.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For adults, youth, and children who are survivors of violence or abuse and who live, work, or go to school in Hays or Caldwell County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para adultos, jóvenes y niños que han sufrido violencia o abuso y que viven, trabajan o estudian en el condado de Hays o Caldwell.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Live, work, or attend school in Hays or Caldwell County

records.how_to_apply: Call the 24-hour HELPline at (512) 396-4357 or (800) 700-4292 for shelter, counseling, or other help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de ayuda de 24 horas al (512) 396-4357 o al (800) 700-4292 para pedir refugio, consejería u otra ayuda.
records.hours: HELPline 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
records.notes: Shelter location is confidential. Office phone (512) 396-3404; mailing address P.O. Box 234, San Marcos, TX 78667. Also runs Roxanne's House children's advocacy center and hospital advocates (HEARTeam).

records.name: San Marcos Housing Authority - Public Housing
records.description_en: The housing authority rents public housing apartments (1-5 bedrooms) at reduced rent to low-income families. It also runs Springtown Villa for seniors and people with disabilities.
records.description_es: La Autoridad de Vivienda renta apartamentos de vivienda pública (de 1 a 5 recámaras) con renta reducida a familias de bajos ingresos. También maneja Springtown Villa para personas mayores y personas con discapacidades.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income households. The housing authority gives preference to people who live or work in Hays County. Springtown Villa is for seniors or people with disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares de bajos ingresos. La Autoridad de Vivienda da preferencia a personas que viven o trabajan en el condado de Hays. Springtown Villa es para personas mayores o con discapacidades.
documents_needed: Birth certificates for all household members
Social Security cards for all household members
Photo ID for everyone 18+
Proof of income (wages, retirement, SSI, TANF, child support)
records.how_to_apply: Download and print the public housing application, fill it out, and bring it with all documents to the main office at 1201 Thorpe Lane. If you need help printing, call (512) 353-5059.
records.how_to_apply_es: Descargue e imprima la solicitud de vivienda pública, llénela y llévela con todos sus documentos a la oficina principal en 1201 Thorpe Lane. Si necesita ayuda para imprimirla, llame al (512) 353-5059.
records.notes: Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher list is CLOSED (not taking applications). Wait is about 6 months to 3+ years. Springtown Villa (1-2 bedrooms, elderly/disabled): 503 Springtown Way, San Marcos, (512) 396-3363. Chapultepec family self-sufficiency housing: apply at 701 South LBJ Drive. Hays County residence/work is a preference, not a strict requirement.

records.name: Bluebonnet Trails Community Services (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Bluebonnet Trails is the public mental health center for this area. It offers a 24/7 crisis line, mobile crisis team, counseling, medication, substance use treatment, and services for people with developmental disabilities and young children with delays.
records.description_es: Bluebonnet Trails es el centro público de salud mental de esta área. Ofrece una línea de crisis 24/7, un equipo móvil de crisis, consejería, medicamentos, tratamiento para el uso de sustancias y servicios para personas con discapacidades del desarrollo y niños pequeños con retrasos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people living in Bastrop, Burnet, Caldwell, Fayette, and Lee counties (also Gonzales, Guadalupe, and Williamson). Anyone in crisis can call the crisis line.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en los condados de Bastrop, Burnet, Caldwell, Fayette y Lee (también Gonzales, Guadalupe y Williamson). Cualquier persona en crisis puede llamar a la línea de crisis.
records.how_to_apply: For a crisis, call (800) 841-1255 any time. For services and appointments, call (844) 309-6385.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si tiene una crisis, llame al (800) 841-1255 a cualquier hora. Para servicios y citas, llame al (844) 309-6385.
records.notes: LMHA assignment confirmed on the Texas HHS LMHA finder. Local offices (all use 1-844-309-6385): Bastrop - 275 Jackson St 78602; Giddings - 849 E Industry St 78942; La Grange - 750 West Travis St 78945; Lockhart - 2060 S. Colorado St 78644; Marble Falls - 4606 Innovation Loop 78654 (from https://bbtrails.org/locations). Mobile crisis team responds 24/7. Appointment-line hours were inconsistent across sources, so they were removed.

records.name: Hill Country MHDD Centers (Local Mental Health Authority) - Hays, Blanco, Llano
records.organization: Hill Country Mental Health & Developmental Disabilities Centers
records.description_en: Hill Country MHDD is the public mental health center for Hays, Blanco, and Llano counties. It offers a 24/7 crisis hotline, mental health care, counseling, and developmental disability services.
records.description_es: Hill Country MHDD es el centro público de salud mental para los condados de Hays, Blanco y Llano. Ofrece una línea de crisis 24/7, atención de salud mental, consejería y servicios para discapacidades del desarrollo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people living in Hays, Blanco, Llano, and other Hill Country counties. Anyone in crisis can call the hotline.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que viven en los condados de Hays, Blanco, Llano y otros condados del Hill Country. Cualquier persona en crisis puede llamar a la línea de crisis.
records.how_to_apply: For a crisis, call 1-877-466-0660 any time. For services, call your local county clinic.
records.how_to_apply_es: Si tiene una crisis, llame al 1-877-466-0660 a cualquier hora. Para servicios, llame a la clínica de su condado.
records.notes: LMHA assignment confirmed on the Texas HHS LMHA finder. Clinics: Hays County Mental Health (Scheib Center), 1200 N Bishop St Ste 200, San Marcos, (512) 392-7151; Hays County LIDDA, 631 Mill St Ste 100, San Marcos, (512) 558-2006; Kyle, 1300 Dacy Lane Ste 120-130, (512) 392-8953; Blanco County, 206 S Hwy 281, Johnson City, (512) 392-8953; Llano County, 100 Legend Hills Ste B, Llano, (325) 247-5895.

records.name: Child Care Scholarships (Child Care Services)
records.description_en: Child care scholarships help working families, students, and people in training pay for child care.
records.description_es: Las becas de cuidado infantil ayudan a familias que trabajan, estudian o están en capacitación a pagar el cuidado de sus hijos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For families at or below 85% of State Median Income living in the Rural Capital counties. Single parents must work, study, or train at least 25 hours a week on average (50 combined hours for two-parent homes).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias con ingresos del 85% o menos del Ingreso Medio del Estado que viven en los condados de Rural Capital. Los padres solteros deben trabajar, estudiar o capacitarse por lo menos 25 horas por semana en promedio (50 horas entre los dos en hogares con dos padres).

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Bastrop, Blanco, Burnet, Caldwell, Fayette, Hays, Lee, Llano, or Williamson County

records.how_to_apply: Apply on the Texas Child Care Connection portal. Questions: call 1-877-223-0404 or email rcachildcareservices@ruralcapital.net.
records.how_to_apply_es: Solicite en el portal Texas Child Care Connection. Preguntas: llame al 1-877-223-0404 o escriba a rcachildcareservices@ruralcapital.net.
records.cost: Parent share of cost based on income
records.notes: There is a waitlist; priority groups include TANF, SNAP E&T, and transitional care recipients, then children of veterans, foster youth, homeless children, military families, teen parents, and children with disabilities. Income limit is 85% of State Median Income (SMI), not FPL. Fax 855-584-7332.

records.description_en: Free job search help, resume and interview help, computers, job fairs, online training courses, and veteran services.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo: hacer su currículum, prepararse para entrevistas, usar computadoras, ferias de empleo, cursos en línea y servicios para veteranos.

records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro o llame. Los beneficios de desempleo los maneja TWC al (800) 939-6631.
records.notes: General line: 1-844-344-2780. Hours not listed on the locations page.
